questions.question: If 3x + 5 = 20, what is the value of x?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the sum of the interior angles of a triangle?
questions.explanation: The interior angles of any triangle always sum to 180°.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of Newton's laws explains why a passenger jerks forward when a bus suddenly stops?
questions.explanation: This is inertia of motion, described by Newton's First Law.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which element has the chemical symbol 'Na'?
questions.explanation: Na comes from the Latin 'Natrium', meaning Sodium.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A solution with pH 3 is considered:
questions.explanation: A pH below 7 indicates an acidic solution.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which organ is primarily responsible for pumping blood through the body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: DNA is found mainly inside which part of the cell?
questions.explanation: DNA is stored in the nucleus of eukaryotic cells.
